rounds.name: Tarifa / Punta de Tarifa
rounds.fact: Punta de Tarifa in Andalusia is the southernmost point of the Iberian Peninsula and of continental Europe.

rounds.name: Red Sea / Dahlak Archipelago
rounds.fact: The Dahlak Archipelago is an island group off the coast of Eritrea in the southern Red Sea known for marine pearl fisheries.

rounds.name: Galapagos Islands
rounds.fact: The Galapagos Islands are an isolated volcanic archipelago in the Pacific Ocean distributed on both sides of the equator.

rounds.name: Persian Gulf / Musandam
rounds.fact: The Musandam peninsula is an exclave of Oman projecting into the Strait of Hormuz characterized by dramatic fjord-like khors.

rounds.name: Whitsunday Islands
rounds.fact: The Whitsunday Islands are a collection of continental islands off the central coast of Queensland, Australia, bordered by the Great Barrier Reef.
